test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

42 × 7 ÷ 13 - 87 + 12 = ?
solution:
Given equation: 42 × 7 ÷ 13 - 87 + 12 = ?

If '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged, then the equation becomes:

__**42 ÷ 7**__ × 13 + 87 - 12 = ?

⇒ 6 <span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);&quo
